svg.title: Traffic officer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as traffic officer, wearing a safety vest and a service cap. Visible work cue: An octagonal traffic-stop paddle is paired with a separate striped traffic cone. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
